message.title: Successful sale of existing shares in Aker BP ASA
message.body:
NOT FOR RELEASE, PUBLICATION OR DISTRIBUTION, IN WHOLE OR IN PART, DIRECTLY OR INDIRECTLY, IN OR INTO THE UNITED STATES, AUSTRALIA, CANADA, HONG KONG, JAPAN OR ANY JURISDICTION IN WHICH SUCH RELEASE, PUBLICATION OR DISTRIBUTION WOULD BE UNLAWFUL. THIS ANNOUNCEMENT DOES NOT CONSTITUTE AN OFFER OF ANY OF THE SECURITIES DESCRIBED HEREIN.

5 November 2026

Reference is made to the announcement on 4 November 2026 regarding a possible block sale of existing shares in Aker BP ASA ("Aker BP" or the "Company") by BP Exploration Operating Company Limited ("bp" or the "Seller"). bp has successfully sold 31,602,000 shares in the Company, representing approximately 5% of the shares outstanding, at a price of NOK 311 per share, raising gross proceeds of approximately NOK 9.83 billion ($1.06 billion) (the "Offering").

Following the Offering, bp will hold 68,700,878 shares in the Company, representing approximately 10.9% of the shares outstanding. bp has entered into a 90-day lock-up for its remaining shares in the Company, subject to customary exemptions.

Barclays acted as Sole Global Coordinator and Bookrunner and DNB Carnegie acted as Co-Bookrunner in the Offering. Thommessen AS acted as Norwegian legal advisers.

For more information about the Offering, please contact one of the Managers:
Barclays - Sole Global Coordinator and Bookrunner: +44 (0)20 7623 2323
DNB Carnegie - Co-Bookrunner: +47 (0)24 1690 20
